diagnostics.summary: argument `value` for `List.push` uses `take` but the parameter is `read`.
diagnostics.label: data effect mismatch
causes: A bare argument is `read`; `mut` and `take` must be written explicitly and match the parameter.

fixes.title: Remove `take` from `value`: a `read` parameter takes the bare value.

diagnostics.summary: managed value cannot be converted to local binding `record_id`.
diagnostics.label: managed value used as local
causes: `id` is already managed; RSScript has no managed -> local conversion.

fixes.title: Create the value as `local` at its creation point.

diagnostics.summary: retaining API `List.push` cannot retain local value `item`.
diagnostics.label: local value retained
causes: `List.push` declares `retains(value)`.

fixes.title: Pass `value` through `manage item` before retaining it.

diagnostics.summary: arithmetic operators are only built in for numeric values.
diagnostics.label: operator on non-numeric value
causes: RSScript does not support user-defined operator overloads.

fixes.title: Use a named function such as `Type.add(left: read a, right: read b)`.
